The latest version of dcpTool can be downloaded from the dcpTool download page at SourceForge.net.
 
Alternatively, if you are at the the dcpTool project page, do the following:
 
  1. 1.Click the “Download” menu option from the menu items below the page title.
  2. 2.If a list of packages is displayed, click the “Download” option next to the dcpTool package. If no list of packages is displayed, go directly on to step 3.
  3. 3.Click the most recent dcpTool file. This one file has all the executable files, source code and documentation in it.
